import sys, random, itertools

import exact_ref as R, fuzz2 as F2, fuzz3 as F3
rng=random.Random(77)
bad=0; checked=0
for t in range(4000):
    rib, ixps = F2.gen(rng, rng.random()<0.5)
    core, scopes, rounds, finals = F2.core_of(rib, ixps)
    fl=set()
    for p in finals:
        for i in range(len(p)-1): fl.add(R.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
    checked+=1
    if set(core)-fl:
        bad+=1
        if bad<4: print('CORE LINK MISSING FROM FINALS', core, fl, rounds, finals)
print('checked',checked,'bad',bad)
